rss: Beauty advent calendars can cost hundreds but are they value for money?
title: Candy Calendars: Are They Worth It?
story: Candy calendars are fun and popular during holidays. They have surprises inside but can be expensive. Do you think they're worth spending your money on?
storyBig: Candy calendars have become a staple holiday item, offering a sweet surprise each day. However, the price of these calendars can be quite high. It's important to consider if the joy they bring is worth the cost.
think: Would you buy a candy calendar if you had to save up for it?
bull: Candy calendars make every day feel special!
bear: What if the candy inside isn't your favorite?

rss: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
title: Tech Trouble: Games Back Online!
story: A big computer problem made some games stop working for a whole day! Now, everything is fixed, and kids can play their favorite games again.
storyBig: A significant software outage caused disruptions for many users, affecting access to various tech services. The issue has now been resolved, and normal operations have resumed.
think: How would you feel if you couldn't play your favorite game for a day?
bull: All games are back, so playtime is on!
bear: A day without games can be really boring.
